findings.F1_late_commit_L_star_edge: CONFIRMED (coordinator's watch item; SIM): at the L* = 1.3 s edge the late-commit contingency does not land. e19|G73|ant13 (commit lead p50 1.31 s): P 0.000 / 0.012 (A1_none / A1J_pc) with the nominal start and 0.000 / 0.000 with the L400 start. Mechanism: the flight software holds T_fire until 1.9 s of flow (amendment G pgg_Tmin, lead 164 (2)), so the light comes 0.99 s (p50) after the plain trigger, E0 at 22.3 m (p50), too low to arrest the descent (tipover / no touchdown). At lead 1.7 s: 0.758 / 0.780 nominal, 0.000 / 0.000 L400; at 2.1 s: 0.990 / 0.990 nominal, 0.640 / 0.720 L400; at 2.5 s: 0.996 / 0.990 nominal, 0.786 / 0.854 L400; decided horizon 2.90 s: 0.992 / 0.990 nominal, 0.940 / 0.952 L400. The baseline below L* (no purge, no unpurged relight) is a vehicle loss, so purging at >= 1.3 s is never worse than skipping, but the contingency band 1.3-1.7 s carries P_GNC ~0 (L400) to ~0.78 (nominal start). Holds with and without L400; not a physical result (canopy, valve timing and the Tp < 1.9 s outcome class are not modelled)
